Tax is computed on money, so I need exact arithmetic. Float dollars and fractional percents can cause cent rounding errors, and half-up rounding to the cent becomes ambiguous. Counter-proposal: money crosses module boundaries as integer cents (1250 = 12.50 dollars); percents as plain numbers (8.25 = 8.25 percent, 10 = 10 percent). Lookup misses: returning None is fine for pricing get_* functions, but tax.py raises KeyError for an unknown region string; region=None means unknown customer -> 0 tax. Any conversion to dollars belongs in invoice.py display, not in pricing.py.
